source.prompt: TrackType: Music, VocalType: Instrumental. Original instrumental retro fantasy tactical RPG score. Flute-like lead, shimmering short arpeggios, gentle rolling bass and light hand percussion. Human and resilient, not a pirate tavern song. Maintain steady repeating musical phrases throughout, no long introduction, no fade-out or final ending.
